sloka: मधुं च कैटभं चैव ययोरस्थिचयैर्वृता ।इयं पर्वतसम्बाधा मेदिनी चाभवन्मही ।। ७.१०४.६ ॥
transliteration: madhuṁ ca kaiṭabhaṁ caiva yayorasthicayairvṛtā ।iyaṁ parvatasambādhā medinī cābhavanmahī ।। 7.104.6 ॥

translations.english: These two were Madhu and Kaitabha, whose heaps of bones covered this earth, which then became the great earth crowded with mountains.
